17-13-0303-C (1) Type 1 Narrative & Plans - Zoning Map Amendment
4404-4414 South Greenwood Avenue, Chicago, Illinois

Proposed Zoning: RM-5 Residential Multi-Unit District
Lot Area: 22,918 square feet

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant is seeking a Type I Zoning Map Amendment and
secondary Administrative Adjustment relief, pursuant to Section 17-
13-0300 of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, in order to permit the
construction and occupancy of a new townhouse complex at the
subject site, which will feature nine (9) attached three-story single-
family residences (dwelling units) and onsite parking for twenty-
three (23) vehicles. The programming for the proposed new
improvements calls for the establishment of one six-unit townhouse
development with frontage on and facing Greenwood Avenue
(Building 1) and one three-unit townhouse development with
frontage on and facing 44" Street (Building 2). Each townhouse unit
will feature an attached two-car garage, with additional surface
parking for five (5) guest vehicles located at the southwest quarter
of the site, thereby yielding off-street parking for a total of twenty-
three (23) vehicles to serve the nine-unit townhouse complex. Each
of the respective townhouse developments be masonry in
construction and will measure approximately 42 feet-0 inches in
height. *[Please Note: The subject property is located in the North
Greenwood Multiple Resource Landmark District, and — therefore,
the corresponding architectural plans have been reviewed and
approved by the Commission on Chicago Landmarks — Permit
Review Committee, prior to submission of this application (on or
about April 3, 2025).]

(A) _ The Project’s Floor Area Ratio: 31,373 square feet (1.37 FAR) (Total - Two Buildings)
Building 1: 20,692 square feet
Building 2: 10,681 square feet

(B) The Project’s Density (Lot Area Per Dwelling Unit): 9 units (2,547 square feet)
Building 1: Six Units
Building 2: Three-Units

(C) The amount of off-street parking: 23 automobile spaces
Building 1: 12 spaces
Building 2: 6 spaces
Guest Parking: 5 spaces

to reduce or otherwise modify the minimum spacing between rows of townhouses [17-
13-1003-U] andor private yard standards for townhouses [17-13-1003-V].
